description:
Programme Overview

The Global Invisible University (GIU) Fellowship 2027/28 is a fully funded research and teaching fellowship running for 3 to 9 months (residential) or 6 to 12 months (non-residential) at the Institute for Advanced Study, Central European University (IAS CEU) in Budapest, Hungary. Applications close on 1 October 2026 at 11:59 PM CET.

Fellowship Tracks & Financial Coverage

Fellowship TrackEligibilityNet Monthly StipendAccommodation
Senior Residential FellowPhD awarded before 2018€2,600/monthProvided at Raoul Wallenberg Guesthouse
Junior Residential FellowPhD awarded in 2018 or later€1,500/monthProvided at Raoul Wallenberg Guesthouse
Threatened Scholars (Non-Residential)Scholars facing risks or persecution€1,000/month + travel allowancesN/A (funds for short visits)
Residential Affiliated FellowIndependent or sponsored scholarsNo stipendSubject to availability

Additional Benefits

  • Free apartment accommodation at Raoul Wallenberg Guesthouse for residential fellows and families (utility charges apply).
  • Full access to CEU libraries, computer networks, conference spaces, and research centers.
  • Participation in weekly interdisciplinary seminars, workshops, and joint mentoring.

Core Research Priorities

  1. Democratization, De-democratization, and Re-democratization
  2. Politics of History, Memory, Culture Wars, and Transnational Discourses
  3. Political Economy and Global Inequalities
  4. Human Rights and Justice in International and Comparative Law
  5. Crises of Multilateralism and Dynamics of Global Institutions
  6. Politics of the Anthropocene, Climate Justice, and Natural Resources
  7. Old and New Media, Information Warfare, and Securitization
  8. Epistemological Problems of Social Sciences in the Digital Age

Eligibility Criteria

  • Must hold a PhD or equivalent in social sciences or humanities.
  • Must show a record of publications in internationally recognized scholarly outlets.
  • Fluent English communication skills required.
  • Open to all nationalities.
  • Ineligibility: CEU full-time staff and students (5 years after contract/studies end); CEU part-time staff (1 year); former IAS CEU fellows (7 years); maximum 3 applications within 5-year window.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Applications open14 August 2026
Application deadline1 October 2026, 11:59 PM CET
Results notification (selected)Late February 2027
Results notification (general)End of April 2027
Fellowship term beginsAugust / October 2027

Application Process

  1. Compile all materials into a single PDF (max 12 MB).
  2. Submit online through the IAS CEU fellowship portal.
  3. Required documents:
  • Letter of Intent (max 1,500 words)
  • Project Abstract (max 150 words)
  • Research Proposal (1,000-2,500 words)
  • CV and Publication List (max 5 pages)
  • Teaching Philosophy Statement
  • Writing Sample (1-2 publications)
  • Risk Statement (for Threatened Scholars Track)

Official Links

  • IAS CEU Fellowship Program: https://ias.ceu.edu/fellowships-ias-ceu
  • CEU Main Site: https://www.ceu.edu
  • Official Call PDF: https://ias.ceu.edu/sites/ias.ceu.edu/files/attachment/basicpage/561/cfafellowshipsgiu2027-2028.pdf
